Ids are the join key between board, predictions and flags.

checks.check: Every match row carries a pick
checks.detail: Pick = the selection we would back on the highlighted market.

checks.check: Every match row has a low/medium/high label
checks.detail: Labels come mechanically from the thresholds in model_config.json.

checks.check: Every high-confidence pick has a written prediction

checks.check: Every prediction is at least 30 words

checks.detail: Each write-up is written for its own match.

checks.check: Every prediction fact carries a source URL
checks.detail: Official-body vs secondary is tagged per fact and secondary facts are also listed on the flagged page.

checks.check: Predictions cite official bodies where one publishes the fact

checks.check: Unconfirmed values are blank, not filled
checks.detail: Missing tip counts, injury news and form data are declared and left blank in the tables.
